metadata.description: Mikael Lund's collection of Claude Code and Codex skills.

plugins.name: scientific-writing
plugins.description: Write and revise clear, concise, reader-focused scientific prose, combining Nature Masterclasses, Strunk & White, The Economist Style Guide, and Kirkwood-Shumaker-style theoretical exposition.

plugins.name: faunus
plugins.description: Author Faunus YAML input files and build, run, profile, and debug Faunus molecular simulations.

plugins.name: scientific-plotting
plugins.description: Design, create, and review plots and data visualizations for scientific journals, from chart choice and faithful encoding to journal artwork specs.

plugins.name: llvm-mos
plugins.description: Write, debug, and optimize C, C++, and assembly for 6502-family CPUs with the llvm-mos toolchain and SDK: inline-asm constraints, the calling convention, linker scripts, banking, and cc65/ca65 migration.

plugins.name: mega65-dev
plugins.description: Systems-level MEGA65 development: the 45GS02 memory model, MAP and banking, hardware registers, the KERNAL, the Hyppo hypervisor, and xemu-based testing, checked against the MEGA65 core VHDL and the MEGA65 Book.
